description: Prepare a link that opens a property's photo editor on its page (Sepolia Testnet), where the owner adds, removes or reorders photos and videos from their own device and saves; files are not passed through this server. Checks first that the wallet holds at least 50% of the property and that it backs no loan, and reports how many photos it has now. Prepared, not sent: returns a signRequest (summary, warnings, signLink to fabrica.land, expiresAt 15 minutes out, payload null for now) and stores it so the sign page can load it. The person opens the link, signs in with that wallet and signs; nothing happens until then. The server holds no keys and submits nothing. wallet is the address that will sign.

tokenId.description: The token ID of the property

wallet.description: The wallet that holds the property and will sign (0x address). The sign page only lets this wallet sign.
